annotations.title: Upload a file into a draft's field

description: An image file (PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to 4 MB) or a clip (MP4 or MOV, up to 40 MB) is too big to send as a tool argument: this answers the exact HTTP request, and a curl command, that puts the file into one of the draft's image or clip fields, checked like any value. Run it from your shell with the file's path.

editToken.description: The draft's editToken, to write it into the command (left out, the command has a placeholder).

field.description: An image or video field (get_template lists them).

file.description: The file's path, to write it into the command (its extension says its type).

name: media_upload_command
title: Upload a file into a draft's field
